# Super Qi Mini Programs Documentation

> Build lightweight, powerful applications within the Super Qi ecosystem.

## Documentation Sets

- [Super Qi Mini Programs - Full Documentation](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev//llms-full.txt): Complete documentation for developing, deploying, and integrating Super Qi Mini Programs.

## Developers Guide

- [Introduction](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/developers-guide/getting-started/introduction): Welcome to Super Qi Miniapps - Your gateway to building lightweight, powerful applications.
- [What Are Miniapps](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/developers-guide/getting-started/what-are-miniapps): Understanding Super Qi Miniapps architecture, capabilities, and platform features.
- [MiniApps Lifecycle](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/developers-guide/getting-started/miniapp-lifecycle): Complete guide to building and launching your Miniapp on the Super Qi platform.
- [Super Qi Console](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/developers-guide/config-setup/super-qi-platforms): Setting up your account on Super Qi Console.
- [UAT and Credentials](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/developers-guide/config-setup/uat): Setting up your UAT environment and obtaining credentials for Miniapp development.
- [Create Miniapp](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/developers-guide/create-your-first-miniapp/create-miniapp): Creating your first Miniapp on Super Qi Console.
- [Configure & Test Miniapp](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/developers-guide/create-your-first-miniapp/configure-and-test-miniapp): Configuring your Miniapp credentials for UAT testing.
- [Installation Steps](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/developers-guide/demo-miniapp/installation-steps): Installing and setting up the Super Qi Demo Miniapp.
- [Testing Locally](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/developers-guide/demo-miniapp/testing-locally): Configuring and running the Demo Miniapp locally for testing.
- [Frontend](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/developers-guide/demo-miniapp/exploring-the-code/frontend): Exploring the Demo Miniapp frontend code structure.
- [Backend](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/developers-guide/demo-miniapp/exploring-the-code/backend): Exploring the Demo Miniapp backend code structure.
- [Security Review](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/developers-guide/releasing-to-production/security-review): How to obtain a permanent UAT/Test QR code for your Miniapp production release.
- [Merchant Registration](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/developers-guide/releasing-to-production/merchant-registration): Submit your business information to obtain production credentials.
- [Release Production Miniapp](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/developers-guide/releasing-to-production/release-prod-miniapp): Final steps to release your Miniapp to production.

## API Reference

- [Overview](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference): Complete reference for Super Qi Mini Program APIs, flows, and integration guides.
- [Cashier Payment](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/flows/cashier-payment): End-to-end guide for redirecting users to the wallet cashier flow.
- [Authentication](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/flows/authentication): End-to-end guide for authorizing users and exchanging codes for access tokens.
- [Agreement Payment](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/flows/agreement-payment): End-to-end guide for setting up recurring payments via QiCard agreement authorization.
- [Escrow Payment](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/flows/escrow-payment): End-to-end guide for buyer-protected escrow payments with merchant acceptance and customer confirmation.
- [Overview](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis): Complete guide to Super Qi's backend-to-backend OpenAPIs for Mini Programs.
- [applyToken](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis/authorization/apply-token): Exchanging the auth code for wallet access tokens.
- [prepare](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis/authorization/prepare): Initialize a QiCard agreement authorization request.
- [inquiryPayment](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis/payments/inquiry-payment): Poll payment status when asynchronous notifications are delayed.
- [inquiryRefund](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis/payments/inquiry-refund): Poll refund status when asynchronous notifications are delayed.
- [pay](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis/payments/pay): Create wallet payment orders for cashier and agreement scenarios.
- [refund](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis/payments/refund): Initiate wallet refunds for previously completed payments.
- [merchantAccept](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis/payments/merchant-accept): Merchant accepts an escrow payment to begin order fulfillment.
- [confirm](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis/payments/confirm-order): Customer confirms receipt of goods to release escrow funds to merchant.
- [cancel](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis/payments/cancel-payment): Cancel a payment when the payment result has not been returned or merchant decides not to accept.
- [void](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis/payments/void-payment): Void a paid order before payment is captured and return money to the payer.
- [inquiryUserInfo](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis/users/inquiry-user-info): Retrieve authorized user details with an access token.
- [inquiryUserCardList](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis/users/inquiry-user-card-list): Retrieve authorized user bank card list with an access token.
- [inquiryUserAccountList](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis/users/inquiry-user-account-list): Retrieve authorized user bank account list with an access token.
- [sendInbox](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis/messages/sendinbox): Send inbox messages to wallet users via access tokens.
- [sendPush](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis/messages/sendpush): Send push messages to wallet users via access tokens.
- [inquiryMerchantInfo](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/open-apis/merchants/inquiry-merchant-info): Retrieve authorized merchant details with an access token.
- [Overview](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi): Complete guide to Super Qi's JavaScript APIs for Mini Programs.
- [getAuthCode](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/essential-apis/get-auth-code): Request an authorization code that can be exchanged for access tokens and user info.
- [qicardSignContract](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/essential-apis/qicard-sign-contract): Direct users to authorize and sign a QiCard agreement for recurring payments.
- [tradePay](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/essential-apis/trade-pay): Collect wallet payments by redirecting the user to the hosted wallet cashier.
- [getDeviceInfo](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/essential-apis/get-device-info): Retrieve device information and the current user's role (customer or business) to build apps for different user types.
- [navigateToMiniProgram](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/essential-apis/navigate-to-miniprogram): Navigate from your Mini Program to another Mini Program within Super Qi.
- [navigateBackMiniProgram](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/essential-apis/navigate-back-miniprogram): Return to the previous Mini Program after being opened by another Mini Program.
- [setNavigationBar](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/ui-apis/setnavigationbar): Customize the navigation bar appearance with title, colors, and images.
- [multiLevelSelect](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/ui-apis/multi-level-select): Cascade selection picker for hierarchical data like provinces, cities, and districts.
- [alert](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/ui-apis/alert): Display a simple alert dialog with a title, content, and single button.
- [confirm](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/ui-apis/confirm): Display a confirmation dialog with two action buttons for user decision.
- [prompt](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/ui-apis/prompt): Display a prompt dialog with text input for collecting user input.
- [showActionSheet](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/ui-apis/show-action-sheet): Display an action sheet menu with multiple options for user selection.
- [showLoading / hideLoading](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/ui-apis/show-loading): Display and dismiss a loading indicator dialog.
- [showToast / hideToast](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/ui-apis/show-toast): Display and dismiss a toast notification with optional icon.
- [choosePhoneContact](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/ui-apis/choose-phone-contact): Select a phone number from the device's contact directory.
- [datePicker](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/ui-apis/date-picker): Display a date picker dialog for selecting dates and times.
- [chooseImage](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/media-apis/choose-image): Choose an image from the camera or gallery of a device.
- [previewImage](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/media-apis/preview-image): Preview images in full-screen mode with zoom and swipe capabilities.
- [saveImage](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/media-apis/save-image): Save online images to the device camera gallery.
- [getImageInfo](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/media-apis/get-image-info): Get information about an image including dimensions, path, and orientation.
- [compressImage](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/media-apis/compress-image): Compress large images to meet size restrictions for mini programs.
- [chooseVideo](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/media-apis/choose-video): Shoot a video or choose a video from the album.
- [getStorage](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/storage-apis/get-storage): Get cached data from local storage by key.
- [setStorage](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/storage-apis/set-storage): Store data with a specified key in local cache.
- [removeStorage](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/storage-apis/remove-storage): Remove cached data by key from local storage.
- [clearStorage](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/storage-apis/clear-storage): Clear all local data cache.
- [saveFile](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/file-apis/save-file): Save file in a local position.
- [getFileInfo](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/file-apis/get-file-info): Get file information including size and digest.
- [getSavedFileInfo](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/file-apis/get-saved-file-info): Get information about a saved file.
- [getSavedFileList](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/file-apis/get-saved-file-list): Get information of all saved files.
- [removeSavedFile](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/file-apis/remove-saved-file): Delete a saved file.
- [openDocument](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/file-apis/open-document): Preview a PDF file within the mini program.
- [chooseFileFromDisk](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/file-apis/choose-file-from-disk): Choose a file to upload from the device storage.
- [getLocation](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/location-apis/get-location): Get the current geographical location of the user.
- [chooseLocation](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/location-apis/choose-location): Open the map to choose a location.
- [openLocation](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/location-apis/open-location): Open a map to display a specific location.
- [request](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/network-apis/request): Network request for a Mini Program.
- [downloadFile](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/network-apis/download-file): Download a file resource to a local location.
- [uploadFile](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/network-apis/upload-file): Upload local resource to the server.
- [share](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/network-apis/share): Share the current Miniapp using Super Qi.
- [getSystemInfo](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/device-apis/get-system-info): Get system information.
- [getNetworkType](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/device-apis/get-network-type): Get the network type.
- [Clipboard](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/device-apis/clipboard): Get and set clipboard data.
- [getBatteryInfo](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/device-apis/get-battery-info): Get battery level and charging state of the device.
- [Screen Brightness](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/device-apis/screen-brightness): Get and set screen brightness.
- [addPhoneContact](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/device-apis/add-phone-contact): Add a contact to the user's phone via a form or pre-filled data.
- [makePhoneCall](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/device-apis/make-phone-call): Initiate a phone call to the given number.
- [scan](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/device-apis/scan): Open the scanner to read QR codes or barcodes.
- [vibrate](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/jsapi/device-apis/vibrate): Trigger device vibration.
- [Common Error Codes](https://superqi-dev-docs.pages.dev/api-reference/common-error-codes): Error codes shared across all Super Qi Open APIs.
